lines.zh: 我走得比配偶更稳，也更近
lines.en: I walk steadier than my mate, and closer.

lines.zh: 我踩着枯草走近，草就不见了
lines.en: I walk the dead grass, and it vanishes.

lines.zh: 我的脖子细长，头一直朝前
lines.en: My neck is long and thin, head always forward.

lines.zh: 我不绕开倒木，直接跨过去
lines.en: I do not go around dead logs; I step over them.

lines.zh: 我的影子在地上像一根绳子
lines.en: My shadow lies on the ground like a rope.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低，走得很平
lines.en: I keep my body low and level.

lines.zh: 我跟着血色走，那是最快的路
lines.en: I follow the blood; that is the quickest way.

lines.zh: 每走一步，我就离你近一点
lines.en: Every step brings me closer.

lines.zh: 我的脚趾扣着土，不留印
lines.en: My toes grip the soil without leaving prints.
I walk ahead of my mate to scout.

lines.zh: 我不东张西望，我只看你
lines.en: I do not look around; I look only at you.

lines.zh: 走近的时候，我连呼吸都放轻
lines.en: As I close in, I even soften my breathing.

lines.zh: 我蹲在枯草里，像被风吹弯的枝
lines.en: I crouch in the dead grass like a bent branch.

lines.zh: 我的肋骨在皮肤下起伏
lines.en: My ribs rise and fall under the skin.
I hold still because I am listening.

lines.zh: 这片原野是我先找到的
lines.en: I found this stretch of plains first.

lines.zh: 我把头侧过去，露出颈上的纹
lines.en: I turn my head, baring the marks on my neck.

lines.zh: 我嘴里含着一点没咽下去的东西
lines.en: I hold something in my mouth, unswallowed.

lines.zh: 我数着你的脚步，一下，一下
lines.en: I count your steps, one by one.

lines.zh: 我的手指很长，一节一节的
lines.en: My fingers are long, jointed.

lines.zh: 风把我的气味送过去，故意的
lines.en: I let the wind carry my scent to you, deliberately.
I lower my eyes as if dozing.

lines.zh: 这一带的草我都会记着
lines.en: I will remember every blade of grass here.
I lick my teeth slowly.

lines.zh: 我不需要同伴守着，我也能守
lines.en: I need no one to keep watch; I can.
The ground nearby is sinking.
When I wait, I am never restless.
I push a dead branch aside.

lines.zh: 我的喉咙在动，像已经咽了
lines.en: My throat moves, as if already swallowing.

lines.zh: 你迟早会走到我这边来
lines.en: Sooner or later you will walk to my side.

lines.zh: 我把头抬起来，正对你的脸
lines.en: I raise my head level with your face.
Your scent is clearer than the wind.

lines.zh: 我歪了一下脖子，骨头响
lines.en: I tilt my neck; the bones click.
You are a little taller than me.

lines.zh: 我伸出一只手，停在半空
lines.en: I reach out a hand and stop mid-air.
You blinked first.

lines.zh: 我不逃，我是来找东西吃的
lines.en: I do not run; I came to eat.
My teeth are small, but numerous.
I have walked the road behind you.

lines.zh: 你说话的力气，我不浪费
lines.en: I will not waste strength on speech.
One step lies between us.
I shift forward half a step, very small.
I back half a step without a sound.
That tore my skin.
My teeth clench, and not from pain.
The wound is dry, no blood.
I watch you, closer than before.
I press the broken place.
Pain will not make me run.

lines.zh: 我抬手，把伤口撕得更大
lines.en: I widen the wound with my own hand.
You must be hungry too.

lines.zh: 有东西进来了，我闻到了
lines.en: Something came in; I smell it.

lines.zh: 我伸出舌头，舔了下空气
lines.en: I put out my tongue and taste the air.
I need not look at what you hold.

lines.zh: 我慢慢靠近，脚都不出声
lines.en: I approach slowly, my feet silent.
Two bites and that is finished.
I do not snatch; I wait for your hand to loosen.
My head follows your hand.
I open my mouth and do not bite.
The more you retreat, the closer I come.
Hungry so long I would eat soil.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我脚下的土裂了
lines.en: You hit me and the soil cracks underfoot.

lines.zh: 我没有退，反而靠得更近
lines.en: I do not retreat; I lean closer.
My body is heavier than it looks.
That knocked you two steps back.

lines.zh: 我的手指擦过你的袖子
lines.en: My fingers brush your sleeve.
I held; you nearly fell.

lines.zh: 我们撞上时，我闻到你的血
lines.en: When we collided, I smelled your blood.

lines.zh: 枯草被我们压断了一片
lines.en: We crushed a patch of dead grass.

lines.zh: 我抬手扶了你一下，很轻
lines.en: I put a hand out and steady you, lightly.

lines.zh: 这个距离，我不会放你走
lines.en: At this distance, I will not let you go.
He is leaner than me, and slower.

lines.zh: 我们一起守着这片原野
lines.en: We keep this stretch of plains together.
I walk in front; he follows.

lines.zh: 两颗饥饿之牙并排放着
lines.en: Two hunger teeth laid side by side.
We do not fight; there is enough for two.
His shadow is longer than mine.

lines.zh: 风把他的气味吹给我，我认得
lines.en: The wind brings his scent; I know it.
We wait together, and wait longer.

lines.zh: 倒下一个，另一个会继续
lines.en: If one falls, the other continues.

lines.zh: 原野会记住我们这一对
lines.en: The plains will remember the two of us.
I pick it up and push it into my mouth.
This cracks when bitten.
I sniff it all over before keeping it.
It dries quickly.
I hang it around my neck.

lines.zh: 我拿了一下，又放回去了
lines.en: I lift it, then put it back.
There is nothing else on the ground.
I bury it in the dry soil.

lines.zh: 捡起来是为了让你看见
lines.en: I pick it up so you see me do it.
You are the only thing still moving here.
I have started following.

lines.zh: 不管你跑多快，我都记住了方向
lines.en: However fast you run, I have your direction.
I am hungry, and very clear-headed.
That way is a dead end.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，准备快起来
lines.en: I drop low, ready to speed up.
Nothing else lives here; only you.
You are going deeper.
You are the one.
I follow behind, never falling back.
You cross the gully; so can I.
Your panting is useful to me.
I do not scream; you would only speed up.
My steps overlap yours.

lines.zh: 树越来越少，你藏不住了
lines.en: Fewer trees now; you cannot hide.
I am waiting for your legs to weaken.
Your sweat smells stronger now.
For the last few steps, I will run.
I bite your wrist.
Nails rake first, then the bite.
I lunge in from the side.
My teeth are small, but they sink deep.
Only when I hold you do I feel settled.

lines.zh: 你挣了一下，我咬得更紧
lines.en: You struggle, and I clamp tighter.
I saved the rest for later.
I lick the corner of my mouth.

lines.zh: 血滴在枯草上，很快被吸干
lines.en: Blood drips on the dead grass and is drunk up.
I am hungry again.
A patch of dead grass falls flat first.

lines.zh: 我从原野的深处走出来
lines.en: I come out of the deep plains.

lines.zh: 这里的土还是软的，正合适
lines.en: The soil here is still soft; suitable.

lines.zh: 我不是跟着谁来的，我本来就住这
lines.en: No one led me; I live here.

lines.zh: 我的第一口气，把草吹黄了
lines.en: My first breath yellows the grass.
Footsteps far off, very light.

lines.zh: 我从配偶的身后绕出来
lines.en: I come around from behind my mate.
This place smells new.

lines.zh: 我站在倒木上，看得很远
lines.en: I stand on a fallen log and see far.
The plains end here.

lines.zh: 我落下来时，土往下陷了一寸
lines.en: When I land, the soil sinks an inch.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看了一圈，记住了
lines.en: I scan once and memorize.

lines.zh: 火烧掉我一层皮，我抖了抖
lines.en: Fire burns a layer off; I shudder.

lines.zh: 我摔下去，骨头散了又合
lines.en: I fall, bones scattering and rejoining.

lines.zh: 水灌进我身体，我变重了
lines.en: Water fills me and I grow heavy.

lines.zh: 气浪把我推得翻了半圈
lines.en: The blast rolls me half a turn.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进我肩头，我没拔
lines.en: An arrow lodges in my shoulder; I leave it.
That force flattens me.
I have always been starving.
Lightning runs down my spine.
The ground is gone; I keep going down.
